description: Defines classes and interfaces for representing initial positions in Kinesis streams within Spark Streaming, including wrappers for AWS SDK's InitialPositionInStream and utility methods for position translation.

classes.name: KinesisInitialPositions
classes.description: Container class for different initial position strategies in Kinesis streams, including nested classes for specific positions.

classes.name: KinesisInitialPositions.Latest
classes.description: Represents the latest position in the Kinesis stream.

classes.name: KinesisInitialPositions.TrimHorizon
classes.description: Represents the trim horizon position in the Kinesis stream.

classes.name: KinesisInitialPositions.AtTimestamp
classes.description: Represents a specific timestamp position in the Kinesis stream.

methods.name: KinesisInitialPositions.fromKinesisInitialPosition
methods.description: Converts an AWS SDK InitialPositionInStream to a corresponding KinesisInitialPosition instance.
